questions.question: Write 4 sentences in German about tenses: future and conditional.

points.text: Four sentences using topic vocabulary with correct case endings, verb position and adjective endings. Include at least two different tenses for Higher tier.

questions.question: Write a paragraph (40-60 words) giving your opinion on tenses: future and conditional.

points.text: A structured paragraph: Meiner Meinung nach... (in my opinion), ich finde... weil... (I think... because...), aber/allerdings... (however), zusammenfassend... (in summary). Use connecting words and varied vocabulary.

questions.question: Translate into German: "I think tenses: future and conditional is important because..."

points.text: "Ich finde, dass tenses: future and conditional wichtig ist, weil..." — ensure correct word order (verb at end after dass), correct case endings, and give a specific reason.

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Writing task: Write about the future (werden + infinitive), conditional (würde + infinitive); expressing plans and wishes. <div class="

points.text: A grade 9 answer will: use at least three tenses accurately; include complex structures (subordinate clauses, modal verbs, separable verbs); show precise grammar (cases, word order, adjective endings); express and justify opinions; include cultural knowledge about DACH countries; use a wide range of vocabulary; be well-organised with connecting words (außerdem, jedoch, trotzdem, zusammenfassend). Mark scheme: Content (relevance and detail) + Quality of language (accuracy and range) = total marks
